title: Hypothesis Testing with Conditional Queries: Learnability and the Value of Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2608.06262v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model evaluations may fix all tests before observing any responses or select later tests using earlier responses. We study this choice in a conditional-query model on a finite outcome space $\mathcal{X}$ with $|\mathcal{X}|=N$. We first ask which pairs of distribution classes can be reliably distinguished. We then ask how many additional queries are required to match an adaptive tester when all queried events must be fixed in advance. We show that learnability holds if and only if the two classes have positive separation in their pairwise conditional probabilities. When this separation is zero, the optimal worst-case error is exactly $1/2$ at every finite query budget. For any $T$-query adaptive policy and any $\rho \in (0,1)$, we construct a randomized non-adaptive procedure using $O(N^2(T + \log(1/\rho)))$ pair queries chosen before any response is observed. translated_title: 带条件查询的假设检验：可学习性与交互的价值
translated_abstract: 模型评估可以在观察任何响应之前固定所有测试，也可以利用先前的响应来选择后续的测试。我们在有限结果空间 $\mathcal{X}$（其中 $|\mathcal{X}|=N$）上的条件查询模型中研究这一选择问题。我们首先探讨哪些分布类对可以被可靠地区分；随后我们探讨当所有被查询的事件必须提前固定时，需要多少额外的查询才能与自适应测试者相匹配。我们证明，当且仅当两个分布类在成对条件概率上具有正的分离度时，可学习性才成立。当这种分离度为零时，在任何有限的查询预算下，最优的最坏情况误差恰好为 $1/2$。对于任何 $T$ 次查询的自适应策略和任意 $\rho \in (0,1)$，我们构造了一种随机化的非自适应程序，它在观察到任何响应之前选定 $O(N^2(T + \log(1/\rho)))$ 个成对查询，其模拟的查询记录在总变差距离上与自适应策略相差在 $\rho$ 以内。
tldr: 该论文证明了条件查询假设检验中可学习性当且仅当分布类间存在正的成对条件概率分离度，并构造出一种仅需 $O(N^2(T+\log(1/\rho)))$ 次预先固定查询的非自适应程序，可在总变差意义上逼近任意自适应测试策略，从而量化了交互的价值。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that learnability in conditional-query hypothesis testing holds if and only if the two distribution classes have positive separation in pairwise conditional probabilities, and constructs a randomized non-adaptive procedure using only $O(N^2(T+\log(1/\rho)))$ pre-committed queries that approximates any adaptive testing strategy in total variation, thereby quantifying the value of interaction.
